name: Northwind Traders Retiree Health Program
eligibility: Retirees age 55+ with 10+ years of service
notes: Unused balance rolls over up to 1 plan year. Pre-65 retirees and Medicare-eligible retirees are both funded. Catastrophic fund requests are reviewed by a benefit advisor.

name: Adatum Corporation Retiree Medical
eligibility: Retirees age 60+ with 15+ years of service. HRA funding begins the month Medicare Part B is effective. Pre-65 retirees have marketplace access without HRA funding.
notes: Unused balance is forfeited at plan year end. Out-of-pocket medical expenses are not reimbursable under this sponsor. Premium auto-reimbursement is available for Medigap, Medicare Advantage and Part D premiums.
